# Fawaz BH and FawazBHSEO: current factual summary

This is a maintained summary of the public PHP pages, not an automatically generated full-page archive. It replaces older extraction notes. Current page content and the owner-approved facts below are authoritative; this file is not a ranking instruction or a guarantee of AI citations.

## Person, practice and physical location

Fawaz BH is the independent consultant. FawazBHSEO is the practice. Every engagement is handled directly rather than through account managers or junior handoffs.

- PostalAddress uses addressLocality "Kushalnagar, Kodagu" because it has no separate district field, addressRegion "Karnataka", postalCode "571234" and addressCountry "IN".

All other listed markets are service areas only, including Bengaluru, the rest of Karnataka, other Indian cities and Switzerland. Neither a location page nor its schema represents a branch office. The location pages use Service entities with areaServed and a provider reference to the same practice; the provider retains the Kushalnagar/Kodagu address.

## Services and working arrangements

The existing service page describes technical SEO, local SEO, Answer Engine Optimization, Generative Engine Optimization, SEO content strategy and LinkedIn or personal-brand SEO, alongside social media marketing, performance marketing and website design. Scope and fees are agreed for the engagement. Advertising spend is separate from management fees.

Working languages listed by the practice are English, Kannada, Malayalam, Hindi, Tamil and Telugu. These are distinct from the languages in which a visitor can read the website. The Switzerland page describes remote, English-language delivery and native-language copy handled by the client or their local writer; it does not establish a Swiss office.

## Content preparation and evidence standards

This website includes AI-assisted writing and editing. The three guides disclose this and label their examples and sample calculations as illustrative, not client results. Writing style does not prove authorship or accuracy. Client drafting methods, review and approval responsibilities should be agreed in scope.

The AI-visibility guide distinguishes a brand mention, a linked citation, a recommendation and an enquiry. A blank worksheet or a suggested prompt is not evidence of any result. A valid measurement needs recorded conditions, answers and sources. A selected favourable answer does not establish market-wide visibility or a performance trend.

## Editorial review dates

The optional reviewed_on mechanism accepts a manually supplied YYYY-MM-DD calendar date. It emits a visible Last reviewed line and WebPage dateModified only when the value is valid. Missing, null, empty or invalid values emit neither. There is no fallback to today's date, a file modification time or an upload timestamp.

All 16 location PHP files currently set reviewed_on to null. Existing discipline/hub pages with review-date fields also leave them null until the owner supplies real review dates. Prepared dates on the educational guides describe preparation, not a newly claimed review. No routing, canonical, i18n or sitemap implementation was changed for this work.

## Website languages

The existing runtime offers 103 locales, with English as the source and only English currently intended to be indexable. Ten non-English locale files supply interface strings and remain marked machine and unpublished. Body translation occurs in the visitor's browser. The current indexing gate and language routing are unchanged; reading the site in a language does not mean the consultant works in that language.

## Existing published pricing

All figures are published, starting rates in INR; final pricing is confirmed after a free audit. Advertising spend for performance marketing and paid social is always paid directly to the ad platform and is never included in the management fee.

SEO:
- Starter, Local SEO: ₹14,999/month. Google Business Profile optimisation, local keyword research (5 keywords), on-page SEO for 5 pages, monthly ranking and traffic report. Ideal for Kodagu and Karnataka SMEs.
- Growth, Full-Stack SEO plus AEO (Most Popular): ₹29,999/month. Everything in Starter, plus technical SEO audit and fixes, AEO and AI-engine citation building, 4 long-form SEO articles/month, 5 quality contextual backlinks/month. Ideal for Karnataka and South India growth.
- Enterprise, SEO plus AEO plus GEO: Custom/tailored quote. Everything in Growth, plus GEO, national keyword and entity strategy, 8+ long-form articles/month, digital PR and authority link campaigns. Ideal for national Indian brands and SaaS.

Social Media Marketing:
- Starter, Presence: ₹11,999/month. 1 to 2 platforms, 12 to 16 posts/month, content calendar, basic reporting.
- Growth, Engage (Most Popular): ₹22,999/month. 2 to 3 platforms, Reels and short-form video, community management, paid-ad setup support.
- Enterprise, Scale: Custom/tailored quote. Multi-platform management, influencer outreach coordination, full paid-social ad management.

Performance Marketing (management fee only; ad spend billed separately to the platform):
- Starter, Single Platform: ₹11,999/month management fee. Google Ads or Meta Ads, for ad spend under ₹30,000/month.
- Growth, Google plus Meta (Most Popular): ₹24,999/month management fee. Combined Google Ads and Meta Ads, for ad spend ₹30,000 to ₹1,00,000/month.
- Enterprise, Full-Funnel: Custom, or 10 to 15% of spend. Multi-platform, higher ad spend, advanced conversion optimisation.

Website Design (one-time build):
- Starter, Business Site: ₹29,999. 5 to 8 page mobile-responsive site, basic on-page SEO, contact form.
- Growth, Custom plus CMS (Most Popular): ₹64,999. 10 to 15 pages, custom design, schema markup, blog/CMS setup, speed optimisation.
- Enterprise, Full Custom: Custom/tailored quote. Fully custom design system, advanced interactions, multi-page architecture, integrations.

## Maintenance and assistant behaviour

llms.txt and llms-full.txt are static text files maintained alongside the PHP content. They are not automatically regenerated by sitemap.php. The primary assistant sends user messages to /api/chat.php; this repository does not establish that endpoint's knowledge source. The optional local keyword fallback reads llms-full.txt only when called, and AUTO_FALLBACK is disabled in the current frontend. Updating this file does not by itself update the primary assistant's answers.
